bagPolicy.summary: Small bags such as fanny packs, purses and small shoulder bags are allowed and do not need to be clear. Backpacks and duffle bags are prohibited.
allowed: Small bags do not need to be clear
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched at entry. The venue does not publish a numeric size limit.

parking.note: The venue recommends reserving nearby parking in advance; additional parking is available at Progression Place, 1825 7th Street NW. The Shaw–Howard University Metro station is about one block away.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Howard Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Howard Theatre's food and drink details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Howard Theatre, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed once you leave the venue. If you need to smoke or vape, use the designated smoking area directly in front of the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Howard Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Door and show times vary by show and are listed on the ticketing page, so double check them on show day. Entry is first come, first served, and you can line up whenever you like, though security is not on site until later on show day.
